class.name: ResourceEditor
class.brief_description: The main panel workspace for editing Resources.
class.description: [ResourceEditor] is a Main Panel system that provides dual-mode editing for [Resource] assets. It supports a Visual Mode (graph-based or domain-specific) and a Code Mode (text-based property editing).

method.name: edit
method.description: Opens the specified resource in the editor.

method.name: get_edited_resource
method.description: Returns the resource currently being edited.

signal.name: graph_node_selected
signal.description: Emitted when a node is selected in the visual graph editor.

signal.name: graph_node_deselected
signal.description: Emitted when a node is deselected in the visual graph editor.
